Hey guys!

This subverse was created as the Voat version of /r/IsolatedVocals on that other site.

I hope you guys like it here, and continue to enjoy what's posted, but I'd like to remind everyone about what should and shouldn't be posted here:

  • Please do not post requests. - Guide to Isolating Vocals is linked in the sidebar.

  • Please continue to post direct links to Isolated Vocal tracks, ideally a direct link to a specific track, either on Youtube or Soundcloud. This subverse is listener-focused.

  • Please give your post the appropriate flair: Meta or Vocals Only (for submissions). Also, please let me know if users can't assign flair because I'm still figuring out Voat :)

  • Please keep the sub clean by using the title format in the sidebar Artist - Track (extra info) [Vocals only]. Comments about the song should go in the comments section, not the title.

  • Please remember that Isolated Vocals are different to A cappella tracks (think Pentatonix or similar), please post them to /v/acappella.

That's all, hope you guys continue to enjoy the sub!

If you have any comments, feedback, or complaints, please message me or comment below.
A note: if it turns out that users can assign flair to their posts, the "[Vocals Only]" will not be necessary at the end of the post.

Ween was the ultimate cosmic goof of the alternative rock era, a prodigiously talented and deliriously odd duo whose work traveled far beyond the constraints of parody and novelty into the heart of surrealist ecstasy.
